items.source: An action depending on another action for providing additional information like the id of a parent entity.
items.translation: 一种依赖于另一个动作以提供额外信息（例如父实体的 ID）的动作。

items.source: Represents a delete statement for all entities that are reachable via a given path from the aggregate root.
items.translation: 表示删除所有可通过给定路径从聚合根可达的实体的删除语句。

items.source:
Represents a delete statement for all entities that are reachable via a given path from any aggregate root of a
given type.
items.translation: 表示从给定类型的任何聚合根通过给定路径可达的所有实体的删除语句。

items.source: Represents an insert statement for a single entity that is not the root of an aggregate.
items.translation: 表示针对非聚合根实体的单个实体的插入语句。

items.source: Uses of DbAction.WithPropertyPath in org.springframework.data.relational.core.conversion
items.translation: DbAction.WithPropertyPath 在 org.springframework.data.relational.core.conversion 中的用途
